task_title: Reduce merge conflicts: derive the guard-test registry from the filesystem

plan_review.notes: Separate-model plan review (rubber-duck, gpt-5.6-sol). BLOCKING concern accepted and plan changed: docs/knowledge/agent-memory.jsonl is NOT append-only (scripts/agent/docs/promote-mistakes-lib.ts upserts/replaces the Session_Mistakes entity line; every recent commit is 1 insertion + 1 deletion), so the proposed .gitattributes merge=union entry would silently duplicate the entity and drop observations. Step 4 dropped entirely. Non-blocking concerns also adopted: (a) assert non-empty discovery PER ROOT, not just per group, and reject unknown group names, so a mistyped root cannot silently drop tests; (b) split pure discovery/exec functions into a lib with injected spawn and fixture roots so the runner test cannot recursively invoke the real guards group; (c) anchor discovery at the repo root derived from import.meta.url rather than CWD, emit relative POSIX paths, use process.execPath, and treat spawn errors and signal termination (code === null) as failure. Confirmed no better/smaller intervention: bare node --test globs exit 0 on zero matches, which would weaken the gate.

rounds.notes: High: unsafe slice(root.length+1) path math -> switched to path.relative(). Medium: unbounded argv (161 files) risks Windows 32767-char limit -> added deterministic chunkFiles/ARG_BUDGET_CHARS batching.
No significant issues. Round-1 fixes verified; chunkFiles single-oversized-file edge case correct; fail-closed invariants preserved through batching; test coverage matches claimed behavior.

independent_grade.notes: The diff replaces hand-maintained package.json node-test registries with deterministic filesystem discovery, fail-closed root validation, repo-root anchoring, POSIX relative paths, and bounded batching without weakening the guarded suites. The package.json and README changes are tightly scoped to the conflict magnet, and the new unit tests cover discovery ordering, ignored directories, empty/missing roots, group validation, spawn failures, signal termination, chunking, and multi-batch execution. I found no blocker or high-confidence actionable defect.
